scope: Offline Pythonic motion controls and request-local WITH data; no trajectories or controller acceptance
controls: HOLD/UNHOLD change orthogonal hold flags, preserving idle/executing/stopped work labels; CANCEL clears executing labels while preserving stopped work and holds
selection: Distinct explicit group expressions captured once in source order, or the root-owned set at action execution; atomic ownership/capacity/history preflight
handlers: Controls and logical hands may execute in global handlers; hands are independent of motion holds; linked source calls retain the calling root
lifetime: MOVE/ATTACH/RELEASE require idle unheld groups; automatic acquisition cannot steal held groups; root terminal cleanup releases ownership while retaining labels and hold flags
capture_order: Per-entry group then private value, settings in source order before MOVE operands; current selected group only; no global environment or robot-context mutation
motion_type: Contextual JOINT/LINEAR/CIRCULAR and INTEGER 6/7/8; explicit CIRCULAR requires MOVE TO VIA, other explicit types reject VIA
persistence: Omit empty hold sets; validate typed setting history and control transitions; live ownership is not serializable or restorable
remaining: Other WITH variables and cross-group settings
